description.zh:
环境标识
- DEV：开发环境 
- PROD（默认）：生产环境
description.en:
The environment identifier. Valid values:
- DEV: development environment. 
- PROD (default): production environment.

description.zh: 重跑下游(修复链路数据),可以选择强制重跑
description.en: The command to rerun downstream nodes to fix data link issues. You can choose to force a rerun.
